HOME CONTENTS POLICY
Accidental Damage Cover – Policy Wording "HC-2026"

----------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------
Policy Number:            ND-2026-HC-0015
Policyholder:              Yusuf Demirel
Insured Property:          Amselweg 9, 90411 Nürnberg
Period of Insurance:       01.01.2026 – 31.12.2026
Perils Insured:             Accidental Damage to Household Contents
Sum Insured (Contents):     EUR 20,000
Deductible:                 EUR 50 per claim
Glass Breakage Cover:       NOT INCLUDED (see Clause 2)

----------------------------------------------------------------
1. INSURING CLAUSE – ACCIDENTAL DAMAGE
----------------------------------------------------------------
1.1 We indemnify sudden, unforeseen and accidental damage to
    insured household contents, such as furniture and fittings,
    caused by an identifiable external event (e.g. an object being
    knocked over or dropped against an item of furniture), subject
    to the exclusions below.

----------------------------------------------------------------
2. GLASS BREAKAGE – SEPARATE COVER REQUIRED
----------------------------------------------------------------
2.1 Breakage of glass panes, glass doors or inserts, mirrors, glass
    shelving, and glass tabletops forming part of furniture or
    fittings (e.g. a cabinet door, display case, or table) is
    covered under this policy ONLY where "Glass Breakage Cover" is
    separately selected and shown as included in the Declarations
    of this policy.
2.2 As stated in the Declarations above, Glass Breakage Cover is
    NOT included in this policy as issued. Accordingly, breakage of
    glass components of furniture and fittings is excluded from
    this policy regardless of the cause of breakage, including
    where the breakage results from an otherwise-covered accidental
    event under Clause 1.1.
2.3 Where an accidental event damages both a glass component
    (excluded under Clause 2.2) and a non-glass component of the
    same item (e.g. a wooden cabinet frame scratched or dented by
    the same impact), only the non-glass component is assessed for
    cover under Clause 1.1.

----------------------------------------------------------------
3. GENERAL EXCLUSIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------
3.1 Gradual wear, scratches, or cosmetic marks not resulting from a
    single identifiable accidental event.
3.2 Breakage of glass components of furniture (see Clause 2).
3.3 Intentional or reckless damage by the Policyholder or a member
    of their household.

----------------------------------------------------------------
4. CLAIMS SETTLEMENT
----------------------------------------------------------------
4.1 The claim should describe the triggering event, the item(s)
    affected, and whether the damaged component is glass (excluded
    per Clause 2) or a non-glass structural/decorative element of
    the item (potentially covered per Clause 1.1).

================================================================
Issued by Nordlicht Assurance Group.
================================================================
